pets.note: The pets' jobs (TODO S2). Level 1 is the pet's bonus from its node (always on, nothing changes). Level 2 opens when the NEXT pet has come home (the last pet has no level 2 yet): then the child chooses one of the pet's jobs on the job board, and the pet does it once every question (the same step as everything else; no questions, no work). A job that cannot run just waits (💤 nothing to do, 📦 the store is full). kinds: weeds and stones (take `amount` from the patch that has most; stones go into the store), water (adds `amount` to the water), makes (an item, `rate` per question, whole units arrive). `first`: what a pet with only its level 1 does for the eye: every `every` questions it walks to `place` ('water', 'field', 'spot:<place>') and shows its emoji. Levels 3 and 4 (TODO S5): a pet's level is 1 + the pets that came home after it (at most 4); once the last pet is home (the story is over: free play) every pet is level 4 and the last one has its jobs too. Level 3: the job can have a WHEN card (`whens`: a picture, a name, a slider (`min`, `max`, `step`, `default`) and one condition with `{n}` where the number the child sets goes, in the game's condition language; `allowedWhens` per pet). Level 4: a second rule, read after the first when the first's WHEN does not hold (a job, and a WHEN or always). A rule that cannot run waits. Automated chores (pets-automation, spec in .scratch/): a job of kind `chore` with `chore` (an id of rules/46-chores.json) is one of the farmer's own chores done by the pet at its step: the FARMER pays the chore's effective energy (and water or items), no moment is used, and the pet's chore wears no tool and trains no skill. The target comes from the picker the chore's owner registers (G.actions.register_auto); with no picker or nothing to do the job waits (💤), and a chore that cannot be paid (too tired) waits and says so. `hidden`: true keeps a job out of the list the child sees (jobs_of) while it still exists (job, choose, the state); no job is hidden now, and jobs_of leaves out every chore job anyway (the window lists them as "Helps with", pets.chore_jobs). A rule is a blessing or a chore. Choosing a chore for a rule that has a WHEN card (rule 0 from level 3, rule 1 at level 4) whose WHEN is always sets the WHEN to the `energy` card at its default; choosing a blessing sets that default energy WHEN back to always. The `energy` card: the farmer's energy is at least {n}; one segment of the energy bar is one energy (a cube), `max` is the largest the bar can grow to, `default` is a third of the 40-energy bar of chapter 3 (when a pet first reaches level 3). Each pet has two chore jobs (ids helps_<chore>; the pairs are data); a chore job with `needs` (a place id of places.json) is offered (pets.chore_jobs) only once that place is built.
